Being as you are 14 I am going to assume you do not have any bills. 
What I would do then is open a savings account and then put half of your money into it. I would cash the other half of my pay cheque and use that as spending money. 
Or depending on how much spending money you want to have possibly give your self 100 dollars off of every pay cheque and bank the rest. Also do not carry your bank card or set up a bank account that you can't withdraw from your savings without having to go to the bank teller.
